item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 17/Apr/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. The weather will be relatively humid with a few showers, and hot during the day over the region. With the anticyclone aloft strengthening slightly early next week, showers will ease off and the weather will improve over the coast of Guangdong. A trough of low pressure is expected to bring showers and thunderstorms to southern China in the middle to latter parts of next week.
